title: Patriots place Terrell Jennings on IR, sign two more running backs
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots placed running back Terrell Jennings on injured reserve due to an undisclosed injury.
New England signed JaMychal Hasty and Hasan Haskins as additional running back options.
Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson remain top running backs on Patriots' depth chart.

title: Celtics release 2026-27 schedule: When will Jaylen Brown return to Boston?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown's return to Boston with the 76ers is scheduled for January 21, 2027.
The Celtics will face reigning NBA champion New York Knicks at TD Garden on October 23 for their home opener.
Boston Celtics' 2026-27 schedule includes 27 nationally televised games, highlighting a Christmas Day game against the Miami Heat.

title: Payton Tolle pitches 8-inning gem as Red Sox end 5-game skid with 7-0 win over Blue Jays
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Payton Tolle pitched eight innings, allowing two hits, as the Red Sox ended their five-game skid with a 7-0 win.
Caleb Durbin hit a grand slam in the eighth inning and had a 3-for-5 day to break open the game.
Willson Contreras contributed with an RBI single, while Max Scherzer allowed one run over five innings for the Blue Jays.

title: Patriots vs. Colts live coverage: Who will stand out in Patriots’ preseason opener?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye and several Patriots starters will not play in the preseason opener against the Colts.
A.J. Brown is set for his first game with the Patriots, but may not see action.
The Patriots placed running back Terrell Jennings on season-ending IR, opening opportunities for other RBs.

title: Cape Cod documentarian Mischa Richter creates a dreamy ode to Grateful Dead culture with ‘Summer Tour’
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Mischa Richter's documentary 'Summer Tour' explores Grateful Dead culture through the journey of two young Deadheads on the band's final tour.
'Summer Tour', co-produced with Chloë Sevigny, premiered at Telluride and will be screened in New England cities including Dennis and Westerly.
Richter, a Provincetown filmmaker, aims to capture the Dead's community spirit, drawing on his experiences as a Deadhead and visual artist.

title: Tiffani Faison to close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool’s Errand in the Fenway
author: Nathan Tavares
bullets: Tiffani Faison will close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool's Errand in Fenway by November 24, after 15 years.
Closures are due to cost issues, including high food prices and increased expenses from global supply chain disruptions.
Faison is seeking a new location for Sweet Cheeks and reallocating staff within her Big Heart Hospitality group.

title: Take a look inside New Hampshire’s oldest continuously operated inn after a makeover
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: The Inn at Hancock in New Hampshire, established in 1789, reopened in May after a three-year, multi-million dollar renovation.
Renovations were led by co-owner Kerri Landry and feature whimsical suites, lavish dining rooms, and colorful bars.
Room amenities include bespoke furnishings, modern baths, luxury linens, and services like nightly turndowns and concierge support.

title: Acton teen accused of killing mom, brother ordered held without bail
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Arjun Aravind, 17, charged with murdering his mother and brother, was ordered held without bail at Concord District Court.
The victims, Sudha Venkatesan and Siddharth Aravind, died from homicide involving blunt force trauma, with full causes still pending.
Aravind was arrested in Wayland after a manhunt; he faces multiple charges including murder and vehicle theft in juvenile court.

title: Downtown Boston was buzzing in July. Here’s a look at the numbers.
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Downtown Boston's foot traffic increased 10.5% in July 2026 due to events like the World Cup and Sail Boston.
Weekend foot traffic in Boston downtown reached 104% of 2019 levels, with weekday traffic at 75% and growing.
Temple Place saw a 40% sales increase during the World Cup, boosting interest in permanent late trading hours.

title: 2 seriously injured in West End stabbing, police say
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A man and a woman were seriously injured in a stabbing in Boston's West End Thursday morning, police reported.
The incident occurred on Lancaster Street and is believed to be a domestic dispute, authorities stated.
The man's injuries were self-inflicted and life-threatening; the woman's injuries were not life-threatening, police indicated.
